title: Structured runtime startup and deployment evidence

phases.objective: Replace manual reconstruction of the runtime-startup CI failure with an exact-candidate, bounded, redacted structured artifact that identifies the first failed stage before Job logs are consulted.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Runtime Startup Deployment Evidence on a pull-request merge candidate or explicit workflow dispatch
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The workflow publishes JSON and Markdown proving deployment-manifest validation, manifest generation, and server-startup identity in order, or names the first failed stage with bounded redacted diagnostics while Job logs remain diagnostic-only.
steps: Checkout the exact workflow candidate without persisted credentials.
Validate the structured evidence reporter before using it as the decision source.
Verify that disabled Remote MCP OAuth does not resolve the database pool during route construction.
Generate the deployment manifest for the exact candidate SHA and branch.
Run the server startup and deployment identity smoke test.
Stop after the first failed stage and retain bounded redacted stdout and stderr tails.
Upload the structured JSON and Markdown artifact even when a stage fails.
Enforce the workflow outcome from the structured report rather than reconstructing status from Job logs.
assertions: Pull-request evidence identifies the merge candidate separately from the source head SHA.
Disabled Remote MCP OAuth leaves startup and /version independent from database credentials.
Enabled Remote MCP OAuth resolves its database pool exactly once during router construction.
Every stage records status, exit code, signal, and duration without embedding environment variables or credentials.
Authorization values, OAuth tokens, client secrets, API keys, passwords, cookies, GitHub tokens, and JWT-shaped values are redacted from diagnostics.
The artifact is uploaded under if: always() before the final evidence decision is enforced.
Job logs remain diagnostic-only and are consulted only when the bounded structured diagnostic is absent.

phases.objective: Route the structured report through the trusted canonical PR evidence publisher after the workflow definition is established on the default branch.
Exercise process spawn errors, timeouts, oversized diagnostics, artifact upload faults, stale candidates, and missing-report enforcement without exposing secrets.
Observe the first non-production exact-candidate runtime startup report and verify it replaces manual Job-log reconstruction.
Require canonical structured runtime-startup evidence for protected release promotion and production deployment identity.
